Name: Gothy Tileset Replacers
Author: DexModsOfficial
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/SvYBSIK.png[/img]
[url=https://ko-fi.com/dexmods][img]https://i.imgur.com/DsUcvTo.png[/img][/url][/center]
[color=#000000][font=Courier New][size=6][b]ABOUT[/b][/size][/font][/color]
[font=Verdana][size=3]Overhaul of furniture that I've recolored in a gothy (or monochrome when applicable) fashion. This is an overlay, and will conflict with any other mods that add overlays to the furniture or "craftables" files. Works for players only and doesn't change towns.[/size][/font]

[color=#000000][font=Courier New][size=6][b]FEATURES[/b][/size][/font][/color]
[list]
[*][font=Verdana][size=3]dark furniture set is now actually dark[/size][/font]
[*][font=Verdana][size=3]modern furniture set in goth theme[/size][/font]
[*][font=Verdana][size=3]walnut furniture set in goth theme[/size][/font]
[*][font=Verdana][size=3]brown couches and brown chair are now black[/size][/font]
[*][font=Verdana][size=3]all paintings have a dark frame, the paintings themselves untouched[/size][/font]
[*][font=Verdana][size=3]gothy pirate furniture and decor and...goth fish tanks?[/size][/font]
[*][font=Verdana][size=3]desaturated, gothy wall lights and plant pots[/size][/font]
[*][font=Verdana][size=3]tons more furniture and decor tweaks for a gothy/witchy farmer[/size][/font]
[/list]
[color=#000000][font=Courier New][size=6][b]REQUIRED[/b][/size][/font][/color]
[font=Verdana][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/size]
[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/size][/font]

[b][color=#000000][font=Courier New][size=6]MODS SEEN IN SCREENSHOTS[/size][/font][/color][/b]

Spooky Wallpapers and Floors[/url]﻿ (Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3010]Custom Walls and Floors[/url])
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2847]Hats Won't Mess Up Hair[/url]
